case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (CRL) NO.7099/2018); CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (CRL) NO.7100/2018)

parties.petitioner: B V Seshaiah; B Vamsi Krishna

summary: Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act conviction; compounding of offence via Memorandum of Understanding; binding arbitration clause requiring amicable settlement before litigation; respondent's breach of settlement terms by not filing compromise petition; failure to disclose settlement to High Court; precedent establishing Section 138 as compoundable civil wrong; conviction set aside to allow arbitration.
legal_provisions_cited: M/S Meters and Instruments Private Limited & Anr. Vs Kanchan Mehta (2018) 1 SCC 560
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; parties directed to settle dispute as per Memorandum of Understanding terms.
